functionalRequirement: User shall be able to share files, screen share, conduct group screen sharing, and send contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all specified sharing features (file sharing, screen sharing, group screen sharing, contact sharing) for 100% of intended use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive sharing capabilities, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must initiate file transfers and screen sharing sessions in less than 2 seconds for up to 10 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time collaboration, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for sharing files, screens, and contacts, with clear and consistent button labels (e.g., 'Share File', 'Start Screen Sharing') across all platforms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with sharing features, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must recover from network interruptions or disconnections within 30 seconds, allowing users to resume sharing activities without significant data loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous sharing capabilities, necessitating robust fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all shared files and screen sharing data using end-to-end encryption (e.g., AES-256) to prevent unauthorized access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sharing potentially sensitive data, requiring protection against unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate user credentials correctly for 99.9% of valid sign-up attempts, allowing authorized access to the Snap camera screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate credential validation, ensuring only authorized users access the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20 MB of memory to process sign-up requests and credential validation for a single user.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR's focus on handling multiple user sign-ups.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a clear and concise sign-up process, with fewer than 5 steps required to complete registration and access the Snap camera screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with the sign-up process, which should be easy to learn and use for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process sign-up requests and validate credentials for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the sign-up process, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must store user credentials securely using a salted hashing algorithm (e.g., bcrypt) to prevent unauthorized modification or access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves storing sensitive user credentials, requiring protection against unauthorized modification or access.

functionalRequirement: System shall provide an interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support password reset functionality for 100% of user accounts, allowing Application Administrators to reset passwords as needed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive password reset capabilities, necessitating full coverage of this core functional aspect.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process password reset requests in less than 1 second for up to 100 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves administrative tasks, requiring timely responses for efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords, with clear and consistent button labels (e.g., 'Reset Password') across all platforms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires administrative interaction with the password reset feature, which should be easy to operate for Application Administrators.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must prevent brute-force password reset attempts by limiting the number of attempts to 5 within a 1-hour period.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes secure password reset capabilities, necessitating robust fault tolerance against unauthorized access attempts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify the identity of Application Administrators using multi-factor authentication (e.g., username, password, and email verification) before allowing password reset actions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive administrative actions, requiring verification of administrator identity to prevent unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must accurately calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites using all required geo-location data types (e.g., latitude, longitude) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive distance calculation capabilities, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites in less than 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to geo-location data and calculations, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear API or interface for accessing distance calculations and geo-location data, with consistent parameter naming (e.g., lat, lon) across all endpoints.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with geo-location data, which should be easy to operate for developers or users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform distance calculations and geo-location retrievals for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to geo-location services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user geo-location data using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing user location, which is sensitive data requiring protection.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide comprehensive information on requirements and services for 100% of specified use cases, allowing prospective applicants to make informed decisions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive information provision, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 30 MB of memory to process information requests and service selections for a single user.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR's focus on handling multiple user requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a clear and concise interface for researching requirements and selecting services, with fewer than 5 steps required to complete the process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with the research and selection process, which should be easy to learn and use for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must recover from errors or exceptions within 10 seconds, allowing users to resume the research and selection process without significant data loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to information and services, necessitating robust fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure the accuracy and integrity of provided information, using data validation and verification mechanisms to prevent unauthorized modification or tampering.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves providing critical information to users, requiring protection against unauthorized modification or tampering.
